author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Vase with two blossoms on VRECT_L, mirrored: tall vase with straight neck, belly and narrower foot; two 45-degree stems from the mouth into two quatrefoil blossoms (r3 lobes) that span the 32 width. Reads as flowers in a vase at 48, both themes. Lucide flower informed the lobed blossom idea.
omissions: Reference's small twig leaf on the right stem dropped (no 8-unit room beside the blossom); five-petal blossoms simplified to four lobes (lattice-exact arcs); stems shortened to fit.
